knowledge:
- key_parameters: samplecov=The sample covariance matrix passed as the first argument to EBsingle ;; startlambda=A thresholding parameter used to determine the block diagonal structure of the matrix when groups are unknown ;; n=The number of samples used to calculate the covariance matrix ;; groups=A list of character vectors specifying the elements in each block when the block structure is known
- alternatives: Standard sample covariance (cov) and correlation (cov2cor) without shrinkage, which are prone to high false-positive rates at small sample sizes
- when_to_use: When estimating gene co-expression networks or correlation matrices from transcriptomics data with small sample sizes, where reducing false positives and computational demand is critical
- pitfalls: Setting an inappropriate startlambda threshold may lead to incorrect block diagonal structure estimation. The method assumes a block diagonal structure; if the true covariance matrix does not exhibit block-like behavior, the shrinkage prior may be misspecified.

workflows.name: cov_estimation_unknown_blocks
workflows.intent: Estimate a shrunk covariance matrix from gene expression data when gene groupings/blocks are unknown, using thresholding to determine block structure.
input: Edata (matrix of gene expression values, genes as rows, samples as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter genes based on variance across samples ;; 2. Compute the sample covariance matrix ;; 3. Estimate the shrunk covariance matrix using EBsingle with a starting threshold parameter ;; 4. Threshold the estimated covariance matrix to identify significant correlations and extract network subgraphs
workflows.code:
variances<-apply(Edata,1,var)
edata<-Edata[which(variances>quantile(variances,0.8)),]
covmat<-cov(t(edata))
cormat<-cov2cor(covmat)
out<-EBsingle(covmat,startlambda=0.5,n=40)
outmat<-out
outmat[abs(out)<0.5]<-0
outmat[abs(out)>=0.5]<-1
clusth<-clusters(graph.adjacency(outmat))
sel<-which(clusth$membership==6)
subgraphEB<-outmat[sel,sel]
subgraph<-cormat[sel,sel]
subgraph[subgraph<0.5]<-0
subgraph[subgraph>=0.5]<-1
diag(subgraph)<-0
diag(subgraphEB)<-0

workflows.name: cov_estimation_known_blocks
workflows.intent: Estimate a shrunk covariance matrix when the groupings of variables (e.g., genes in pathways) are known beforehand.
input: samplecov (sample covariance matrix with row and column names)
groups (list of character vectors defining the variable groups/blocks)
workflows.stages: 1. Define the known groups of variables as a list of character vectors ;; 2. Run EBsingle with the groups argument and sample size n to estimate the block-diagonal covariance matrix
workflows.code:
sigma <- matrix(c(4,2,0.5,0.5,2,3,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,3,2.5,0.5,0.5,2.5,4), ncol=4)
x <- rmvnorm(n=500, mean=c(1,2,1.5,2.5), sigma=sigma)
samplecov<-cov(x)
vnames<-paste("a",1:4,sep="")
rownames(samplecov)<-vnames
colnames(samplecov)<-vnames
test2<-EBsingle(samplecov,groups=list(c("a1","a2"),c("a3","a4")),n=500)
